minCoverLS s = sub [] s
  where
    sub acc s = case minCover s of
      (True, t, newS) -> sub (t:acc) newS
      (False, t, _) -> (t, acc)

minCover :: String -> (Bool, String, String)

    sub t "" _ = (False, t, "")
    sub t (c:s) cset | S.null newCset = (True, c:t, s)
                     | otherwise      = sub (c:t) s newCset
      where newCset = S.delete c cset
